_note: Dan select layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. Opacities and shades 0 to 1; a grow is added to a scale of 1.

loading._note: The text shown while the songs are enumerated, centred.

player._note: The nameplate's top-left (x, y); the character's feet at chara_dx / chara_dy from it, the puchichara's at puchi_dx; the mod icons modicons_dy over it (the list only).

menu._note: The two boards side by side (card_*.png, card_w x card_h) centred at (card_cx[i], card_cy), the exit pill (exit_w x exit_h) under them at (exit_cx, exit_cy). The title and the description are one block centred in the board's text band (band_top to band_bottom of card_*.png), the description wrapping at desc_w, title_gap under the title. The chosen board grows by card_grow and lights from card_shade to full; the exit pill grows by exit_grow and lights from exit_shade; its label is exit_text_inset narrower than it.

bars._note: The dan list's side bars: visible_before / visible_after bars around the chosen one, one more than the screen holds at each end, so the bar that slides in on a scroll is already there past the edge. The chosen bar's top-left at (sel_x, sel_y), the others at other_x, gap_y apart; a song's title centred at title_sel_x / title_other_x and title_y (the chosen bar's line, the others' moved with them).

header._note: Header.png's top-left (x, y); the chosen entry's title centred at (title_x, title_y), its subtitle at sub_y.

shortcuts._note: the shortcuts line's top-left; the song speed notice's top centre

confirm._note: The confirm scroll, centred on the screen. The veil tiles dim to veil_opacity. paper_w x paper_h stand in for scroll_paper.png's size before it loads. The options (button_w x button_h art, drawn at button_scale) stand button_gap apart, their centre button_dy under the paper's; the highlight frame is Hover.png from hover_src_y down. The question sits title_dy under the paper's top, fades in over title_fade_px once the open part is title_pad wider than it, and is title_inset narrower than the paper.

contents._note: The chosen dan's songs and exams inside Contents.png, from its top-left. Song bars are clipped to clip_top..clip_bottom. The _fallback sizes stand in for an art's size while it is not loaded.

songs._note: The song bars, gap_y apart from first_y; from scroll_from songs on, they scroll.

song_bar._note: Within DanSong.png, from its top-left: the ordinal stamp (nb) and its text, the difficulty stamp, the level, the title and the genre (sub).

stamp_colors._note: The ordinal stamp's colour of song 1, 2, ...; the last one for every song after; its outline is the colour times outline_shade.

diff_outline_colors._note: The level's outline by difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard, Extreme, Edit.

gauge._note: The gauge exam's bar, filled in fill_color up to its value.

exam_grid._note: The exam bars, two columns of three rows from (x, y), gap apart; a row with one exam uses the long bar.

exam_bar._note: Within an exam bar, from its top-left: ExamName.png, ExamRange.png, the name and range texts' centres, a global exam's value and best score (left edge, vertical centre).

exam_values._note: An individual exam's per-song blocks (ExamValue.png), from start_x of the bar, clipped clip_pad_right before its right end: the ordinal, the value and the best score centred in each block. They scroll from scroll_from_short songs on (scroll_from_long on a long bar).
